text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete. I executed all your
orders
successfully, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I owe it to the effective strengthening of
my body
from incremental, daily
training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I estimate that I now have the ability to
compete
in the Satsuki Sho. Thank you
very much.

We've built a great track record so far,
and now
it's finally time to go for the
Satsuki Sho!
